text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquers the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). The venue erupts in excitement 
over her spectacular race holding off the 
top two favorites.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her heart danced at the thought of the 
Senior Class, stacked with formidable 
rivals. Here, she felt she could reach 
even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen recommended to her the 
first leg of the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown, the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
